sql: select market_ticker, side, action, limit_price, quantity, status, left(cancel_reason,40) cr, created_at::text, left(client_order_id,12) coid, (select string_agg(at::text || chr(32) || residual_cents, chr(124)) from incentive_balance_observations where at > timestamp '2026-10-11 11:00' and residual_cents > 99) credits, (select quantity_fp::text from positions where market_ticker='KXTOP10BBSPOTS-26OCT24-TSWIF-10' order by captured_at desc limit 1) tswif from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-13 15:00' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted') or market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT13-PEAC') order by created_at desc limit 20
